title: KingMC
description: KingMC is a Network with a variety of modes, from EcoSMP to Battle Royale, promising the most intense and thrilling experiences for the Vietnamese Minecraft community.
body: KingMC.VN is a Minecraft server with a variety of modes, from EcoSMP to Battle Royale, promising the most intense and thrilling survival and PvP experiences for the Vietnamese Minecraft gaming community. Join now to prove your skills! ### 🌍 Mega Earth Experience survival on a **realistic large-scale Earth map**. Survive, farm items, claim land, and build your own magnificent structures. ### ☠️ KingSMP A DonutSMP-style survival mode! Building **giant farms**, grinding and become the richest player on the server. Showcase your superior PvP skills in life-or-death battles. ### ⚔️ Battle Royale Experience fast-paced and dramatic Battle Royale. Starting from cornucopia, find ways to gather resources from the overworld, nether, and other players! With customizable items and **Legendary Weapons**, it's an experience like no other.
